crossRefs.note: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

translations.web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
translations.bsb: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
translations.kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
translations.asv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;
